AFK_INFO_MESSAGE: AFK (Away From Keyboard) How it works: When you're away, set AFK mode and the bot will automatically reply to people who mention you. Commands: • /afk - Set AFK with optional reason • /afk [reason] - Set AFK with custom reason Example: /afk Sleeping Auto-disable: AFK automatically turns off when you send a message.
QUOTLY_INFO_MESSAGE: Quotly - Message to Sticker How it works: Convert any message into a beautiful quote sticker! Command: • /q - Reply to any message Features: • Works with text, images, videos • Automatically formats quotes • Creates instant stickers • Preserves user info & timestamp Usage: Just reply to any message with /q
STICKERS_INFO_MESSAGE: Sticker Features Available Commands: 1. Kang Stickers • /kang - Reply to any sticker/image/video/GIF • Adds to your personal sticker pack • Auto-creates new pack if needed 2. Copy Pack • /copypack - Reply to any sticker from a pack • Copies entire pack to your collection 3. Get Sticker Files • /getsticker - Get static sticker as image • /getvidsticker - Get video sticker as MP4 • /stickerid - Get sticker's file ID 4. Manage Packs • Use "Manage Packs" button below • Rename, delete, add stickers • Publish packs for sharing Supported formats: ✦ Images (PNG, JPG, WebP) ✦ Videos (MP4, WebM - max 4MB) ✦ GIFs & Animated stickers
MEMEFI_INFO_MESSAGE: MemeFi MemeFi allows you to add custom text to stickers. Reply to a sticker and use the /mmf command. /mmf Your Text Adds text to the top of the sticker. /mmf Top Text ; Bottom Text Adds text to the top and bottom. Use ; to separate the text. /mmf -c Your Text Adds text in the center. You can combine top, center, and bottom text in a single sticker by using ; and -c. Text is displayed in a classic meme-style font with automatic wrapping. Works with any sticker. Alternate command: /memefi
WELCOME_INFO_MESSAGE: Welcome & Goodbye Messages Customize Messages ✦ /setwelcome reply Set a custom welcome message when a new member joins. ✦ /delwelcome Remove the current welcome message. ✦ /setgoodbye reply Set a custom goodbye message when a member leaves. ✦ /delgoodbye Remove the current goodbye message. Enable / Disable ✦ /welcome on Enable welcome messages in the group. ✦ /welcome off Disable welcome messages. ✦ /goodbye on Enable goodbye messages. ✦ /goodbye off Disable goodbye messages. Available Variables You can use the following variables in welcome & goodbye messages: ✦ {ID} – User ID ✦ {NAME} – User's first name ✦ {SURNAME} – User's last name ✦ {NAMESURNAME} – Full name of the user ✦ {USERNAME} – Username (or None) ✦ {MENTION} – Mention the user ✦ {GROUPNAME} – Group name ✦ {DATE} – Current date ✦ {TIME} – Current time Example ✦ Welcome {MENTION} to {GROUPNAME}! Joined on {DATE} at {TIME} Buttons in Messages You can add buttons to welcome & goodbye messages: ✦ [Button](https://example.com) – Single button ✦ [Btn1](https://link1.com) | [Btn2](https://link2.com) – Two buttons in one row Limits ✦ Maximum 2 buttons per row ✦ Maximum 6 buttons in total Notes ✦ Only group admins can manage these settings. ✦ Text, media and buttons are fully supported. ✦ Bot must be admin to work properly.

LOCKS_INFO_MESSAGE: Locks Lock specific types of content in the group to keep things clean. Commands: • /lock <type> Lock a content type. Matching messages will be auto-deleted. • /unlock <type> Unlock a content type. • /lock all Lock everything at once using Telegram permissions. • /unlock all Unlock everything at once. • /locks See all currently active locks. • /locktypes See the full list of available lock types. Common Lock Types: msg -- Text messages links -- URLs and hyperlinks audio -- Audio files voice -- Voice messages video -- Video messages gif -- GIF animations document -- Documents stickers -- Stickers poll -- Polls allforward -- All forwarded messages bot -- Adding bots invite -- Inviting users pin -- Pinning messages info -- Changing group info Note: Only group admins can use lock commands. Bot needs delete permission for content locks to work.
WARNS_INFO_MESSAGE: Warns Warn users who break rules. When the limit is hit, action is applied automatically. Commands: • /warn @user reason Warn a user. Works by replying too. • /warns @user Check how many warnings a user has. • /rmwarn @user Remove one warning from a user. • /resetwarns @user Clear all warnings for a user. • /warnlimit 3 Set how many warnings before action is applied. • /warnmode ban Set what happens when limit is reached. Modes: ban -- User gets banned mute -- User gets muted kick -- User gets kicked Note: Only admins can warn users. Bots and admins cannot be warned. Default limit is 3, default mode is ban.
BAN_INFO_MESSAGE: Ban & Kick Remove or restrict users from the group. Commands: • /ban @user reason Permanently ban a user. • /unban @user Unban a previously banned user. • /tban @user 1h reason Ban a user for a set time. Format: 1h for hours, 1d for days. • /sban @user Ban silently without any message. • /kick @user reason Kick a user. They can rejoin. • /kickme Kick yourself from the group. • /unbanall Unban all banned users. Owner only. Note: All commands work by replying to a message too. Only admins with ban permission can use these. Max temp ban duration is 30 days.
MUTE_INFO_MESSAGE: Mute Restrict users from sending messages without removing them. Commands: • /mute @user reason Mute a user. • /unmute @user Unmute a user. • /tmute @user 1h reason Mute for a set time. Format: 30m for minutes, 1h for hours, 1d for days. • /smute @user Mute silently without any message. • /dmute @user Mute and delete the replied message. • /dtmute @user 1h Mute for set time and delete the replied message. • /stmute @user 1h Mute for set time silently. Note: All commands work by replying to a message too. Only admins with restrict permission can use these. Max temp mute duration is 30 days.
FILTERS_INFO_MESSAGE: Filters Auto-reply to specific keywords with saved messages or media. Commands: • /filter keyword (reply to a message) Save a filter for the keyword. Bot will reply with that message whenever someone sends it. • /filters See all active filters in the group. • /stopfilter keyword Remove a specific filter. • /stopallfilters Remove all filters at once. Supported Content: Text, Photos, Videos, GIFs, Stickers Note: Only admins can add or remove filters. Filters are not case-sensitive. Bot checks if the keyword appears anywhere in the message.

lock_types_text: Available Lock Types: ── Global ── • all — Lock everything (native Telegram permissions) ── Content ── • msg — Text messages • audio — Audio files and music • voice — Voice messages • video — Video messages • gif — GIF animations • document — Documents and uncompressed files • album — Photo or document albums • contact — Contact cards • stickers — Sticker messages • animations — Animation messages • games — Game messages • poll — Poll messages • checklist — Telegram checklists • inline — Messages sent via inline bots ── Text Patterns ── • links — URLs and hyperlinks • email — Messages with email addresses • phone — Messages with phone numbers • command — Bot commands (e.g. /start) • emoji — Messages containing any emoji • emojicustom — Custom Telegram emoji • webprev — Web page link previews ── Forwards ── • allforward — All forwarded messages • userforward — Forwards from users • channelforward — Forwards from channels • forwardstory — Forwarded user stories ── User Actions ── • bot — Adding bots to the group • invite — Inviting users • pin — Pinning messages • info — Changing group info • anonchannel — Sending as a channel ── Other ── • externalreply — Replies to other-chat messages • comment — Non-member channel commenters Usage: /lock <type> /lock type1, type2, type3 /lock all or /lock everything /unlock <type> /unlock type1, type2 /unlock all or /unlock everything
